# MDB browser regression fixture

`empty.mdb` is the empty Access 2000 database from
https://github.com/andipaetzold/mdb-reader/blob/main/test/data/V2000/empty.mdb
retrieved 2026-09-28. Upstream is MIT licensed; its copyright and license notice
are preserved in LICENSE. No customer or project data is included.

This checks that the browser entry actually initializes mdb-reader and its
Buffer/stream dependencies. It is not a WPCalc calculation acceptance fixture.
